# Kanagawa Palette

Kanagawa Palette applies a Kanagawa-inspired color palette in three variants: a deep ocean Wave, a muted warm Dragon and a warm Lotus light mode. Its CSS is described as a modernized version based on kanagawa.nvim, and Style Settings exposes the variant and font controls.

![Kanagawa Palette screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kmkkiii/obsidian-kanagawa-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Kanagawa Palette"
    author: "kmkkiii"
    repo:   "kmkkiii/obsidian-kanagawa-theme"
    slug:   "kanagawa-palette"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/kanagawa-palette"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/kmkkiii/obsidian-kanagawa-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kmkkiii/obsidian-kanagawa-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Kanagawa-inspired color palette to Obsidian with deep ocean Wave, muted warm Dragon, and warm Lotus light variants. Use modernized CSS based on kanagawa.nvim and enable variant and font controls via Style Settings."
}
```
